messages:
jordan: Hey — first day here, trying to get Grafana edit + Sentry project access for the new infra-service. Grafana panels load but the edit button is greyed out and Sentry says "Project not found". Who should I ping?

maya: @jordan welcome! ping @devex for Grafana perms, @elena usually handles Sentry invites. Also check the onboarding doc: https://docs.redwood.com/obs/onboarding#grafana-sentry

elena: Hi @jordan — I can add you to the Sentry project. I need your org email and the org slug. If you don't know the slug you can run in your browser: https://sentry.io/organizations/redwood/projects/ and look for infra-service. Send me the exact project name and I'll invite.

jordan: Thanks @elena — project name is "infra-service-prod" and email is jordan@redwood.dev. Also quick Q: Grafana alert thresholds live under the dashboard -> Alerting -> Notification rules? I'm trying to reduce noise on the infra CPU panel.

samira: For Grafana alerts we moved most rules into the "platform-alerts" folder. If you're not an editor you won't see the Alerting UI. Once @devex grants edit perms you can: Dashboards -> Manage -> open dashboard -> Panel title -> Edit -> Alert. If it's a legacy rule we might have an instance-level rule in /alerting/rules. FYI, prefer raising a tiny PR in the alerts repo if you want a permanent threshold change so SRE can review. :+1:

devex-bot: Hi! To request Grafana edit rights open the access portal: https://internal.redwood.com/access-requests, select "Grafana Editor" and add the team tag (eng-infra). Typical approval time 1-2 business days. If you need expedited access ping #eng-oncall or react with :rocket: here and include justification.

oncall-bot: @jordan — if this affects production alerts, please add "prod-impact" in the access request and CC @eng-oncall. We monitor alert churn and might temporarily mute noisy rules.

jordan: Got it, submitted request with "prod-impact" and linked this thread. Thanks everyone — will follow up once I have edit and the Sentry invite.

maya: Also re: dashboards — if you tweak thresholds, drop a one-line note in the alert-change log (repo link in the onboarding doc) so oncall can correlate. Thank you and welcome again!
